calculation.policy: actual unmodified application functions, complete past prefix from July 1 at every decision; no serialized parser state or rolling reseed
calculation.validity: actual sigAt validity.ready and actual from-UTC-open day coverage; no score, selected-side, M/W, stopping-volume or tie-policy filter
calculation.bindings: Native Math/Number lexical bindings; optional in-memory memo of actual volumeReference on the immutable fixed-origin numeric input. No recursive indicator, classification or M/W state reused; analyze replays every full prefix. Function bodies unchanged; exact memo/no-memo and reviewed-adapter parity required before full run. Cache never serialized.

episodes.upConvention: close>=open, including doji; doji counts reported

sides.SHORT: up zone with high < decision close
sides.LONG: down zone with low > decision close

episodes.recovery: After source candle through decision inclusive: up-zone midpoint recovered if any low<=midpoint; down-zone midpoint recovered if any high>=midpoint. Equal midpoint excludes both arms symmetrically.
episodes.priorEdgeTouch: After source through decision inclusive: up any low<=high; down any high>=low. Edge touches allowed, recorded as known at decision.
episodes.firstEligibility: one episode per zone at its first eligible valid decision in permitted range, determined before block/tail exclusions; never resurrect excluded episodes
episodes.selection: all eligible zones in both arms; within-arm/side nearest rank by near-edge distance then creation time then ID; not the live nearest-zone estimand

features.stopWindow: decision indices t-19 through t inclusive
features.targets: TP1 near edge; TP2 midpoint; plans anchored at decision close, no next-open reads
features.atrPercentile: (count preceding 288 actual ATR14 values below current ATR + 0.5*count equal)/288, excluding decision ATR; unavailable/nonfinite prior ATR excludes feature construction explicitly
features.calendar: decision-close UTC; weekend is Saturday/Sunday; six-hour bucket=floor(UTC hour/6)

chronology.reservation: include only t+120<blockEnd; coordinates only, never future prices
chronology.sourceCensusBlocks: source creation indices, with pre-permitted separately labeled; not episode decision-block exclusions

matching.caliperBoundary: absolute differences <= declared caliper, no epsilon relaxation
matching.cost: sum over five continuous calipers of (difference/caliper)^2
matching.retuning: forbidden; report poor support/match/balance as findings

diagnostics.smd: (mean V - mean C)/sqrt((sampleVariance(pre V)+sampleVariance(pre C))/2); same pre-match denominator for pre/post within each reported population; no variance recomputation on matched sample
diagnostics.smdFlag: absolute SMD>=0.1; diagnostic only, not exchangeability or inference acceptance
diagnostics.undefined: finite values only with missing counts; pre n<2 in either arm => insufficient-sample, null SMD; zero denominator and equal means => zero-variance-equal/null SMD; unequal means => zero-variance-different/null SMD and flagged; missing matched arm => insufficient-post-sample/null
diagnostics.distribution: finite n/missing/min/max/mean/sample SD and type-7 linearly interpolated quartiles
diagnostics.support: pre-match opposite-arm min/max overlap and outside-range counts; per-V exact-stratum, time-caliper, continuous-caliper and unused candidate counts; no replacement exhaustion separate
diagnostics.overlap: within-arm reserved windows [decisionIndex+1,decisionIndex+120] overlap iff absolute separation<120; report pair count, involved episodes and maximum concurrency pre/post; not independence
diagnostics.calendar: per-arm decision-close day/weekend/bucket concentration plus complete pair decision times, zone times and reserved UTC day spans in local pair payload

canonicalization: Recursive ASCII object-key sorting, array order fixed by coordinates, compact UTF-8 JSON, all numbers finite, no volatile runtime fields. Feature payload includes first episodes and their disposition plus decision/source census; pair payload includes pairs and unmatched diagnostics. Each SHA-256 excludes runtime metadata.

resources.benchmarkAdmission: worst measured prefix seconds * total decision count / workers * 2 safety factor <= maximum wall seconds; otherwise explicit resource refusal
resources.failure: non-complete metadata only, no partial canonical cohort/pair publication; preserve logs; no truncation/reseed or automatic design changes

nextAction: Independent feature/matching/dependence feasibility review, then freeze a separate outcome/inference protocol before any resolution, execution or outcome analysis
